name: Loramus Thalipedes
summary: On a remote isle off Azshara's coast, Loramus Thalipedes keeps three felhounds close. His hunt leads to Razelikh the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

sections.title: The Blind Hunter of the Isles
sections.body: Southeast of Hetaera's Clutch, Loramus Thalipedes watches from a solitary island. An exile among his kin, he is a demon hunter who endured the agonizing ritual of blinding himself for spectral sight. Raytaf, Shahiar, and Zaman, three towering felhounds, stand around him. From the island, Loramus watches demonic corruption stir across Azeroth and keeps vigil over Azshara's shattered ruins.

sections.title: A Vendetta Across Continents
sections.body: Loramus Thalipedes has set his sights on Razelikh the Defiler, a dreadlord in the Blasted Lands. Ordinary steel cannot kill a cunning demon for good, so Loramus guides travelers through ancient rites. They must gather Azsharite and Razelikh's true name to forge Felbane weapons. These preparations will strip away the dreadlord's wards, bind his true name, and bring Loramus's vendetta to an end.

aliases: who is the demon hunter in azshara
faq.answer: Loramus Thalipedes is a night elf demon hunter living on an isolated island off Azshara's coast. He is devoted to thwarting powerful demons, especially Razelikh the Defiler.

aliases: why does loramus have no eyes
faq.answer: Like other demon hunters, Loramus gave up his eyes. The ritual exchanged ordinary mortal vision for the spectral sight he needs to detect demonic energies.

faq.q: Why are there felhounds guarding him?
faq.answer: Loramus has mastered and bound three powerful felhounds: Raytaf, Shahiar, and Zaman. He turns their predatory instincts against demons rather than the Burning Legion.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Blasted Lands?
aliases: why does he care about the blasted lands
faq.answer: Loramus directs the campaign against Razelikh the Defiler, who rules the heights of the Blasted Lands. He provides the knowledge, rites, and weapons needed to pierce Razelikh's protections.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may find demon hunters' ritual self-mutilation and demonic pacts horrifying and worthy of distrust. Your people regard this path as an unforgivable echo of Illidan's betrayal.
As a warlock, you may recognize Loramus's controlled felhounds as proof of exceptional mastery over demons. He binds demons to slaughter their own kind.
